BiblicalUsage: Achari is the Aramaic word for other, another kingdom, another beast. In Daniel 2:39 another kingdom shall arise after Nebuchadnezzar's, and in Daniel 7:5 another beast, a second, like a bear, rises in the vision.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the kingdoms of men rise one after another and fall the same way, and only the kingdom of God stands for ever.
